params.name: elementValue
params.description: Receives the value of the XML element

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If elementValue's variable type is not defined, Text is used by default.

params.name: cDATA
params.description: Receives the contents of the CDATA section(s) of the element

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If cDATA's variable type is not defined, Text is used by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the value of an XML element and, optionally, the contents of its CDATA section(s).

constraints: If the element was a BLOB set via DOM SET XML ELEMENT VALUE, its value was automatically base64-encoded; this command automatically attempts to base64-decode it back.
